generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The removal of the check for nested fields when the index is in time series mode could lead to issues if nested documents are added later without proper validation. Ensure that there is a mechanism to prevent or handle nested fields in time series indices.

review_comment: Maybe we should add an assert that `getRoutingFields()` doesn't return a reference to `RoutingFields.Noop#INSTANCE`? Just to make sure we are able to collect dimension values in order to generate _tsid / _id at a later stage?
